findings.description: Docs still describe the old hook: docs/workflow.md:33 and :47 say pre-commit "Runs `TEST_CMD`", CONTRIBUTING.md:22 says it lints "the staged sources" and "runs the test suite", README.md:157 says it "runs the tests before every commit", and in the restored config .claude/hooks/README.md:15 ("runs `TEST_CMD`, the full Vitest suite") and .claude/project.env:18 ("Run by scripts/pre-commit") are also stale. The hook now runs only `vitest related` on staged sources and uses TEST_CMD only as an on/off switch.

ADR 0132 says no test is selected for a change to `vitest.config.ts`, but that file ends in `.ts`, so it lands in STAGED_SOURCE and goes to `vitest related`. vitest's default forceRerunTriggers (`**/{vitest,vite}.config.*/**`) then reruns every spec, so staging the config runs the full suite. That is the safe direction, but the ADR sentence is wrong.

ADR 0132's "What the hook runs" paragraph says a docs-only commit "still runs lint ... and typecheck, as before". Before this PR, lint was gated on STAGED_SOURCE, so a docs-only commit ran no lint. Only typecheck is "as before".

`git diff --cached --name-only` without `-z` C-quotes names that contain non-ASCII characters (under the default core.quotePath), `"`, `\` or control characters, for example `"caf\303\251.test.ts"`. Such a name ends in `"`, so the extension grep drops it from STAGED_SOURCE and its related tests never run. Lint now gets every staged file, so it receives a path that does not exist. Reading with `-z` fixes both.

The test fixture's LINT_CMD (`pnpm exec biome check`) leaves out `--no-errors-on-unmatched`. The hook now relies on that flag for docs-only commits, so nothing would catch it being dropped from project.env. Separately, the "blocks the commit when a related test fails" test only asserts a non-zero status, so an earlier crash in the hook would also pass it.

The comment above RELATED_TEST_CMD restates the STAGED_SOURCE condition and repeats the header's "never TEST_CMD" caveat. The only fact not stated elsewhere is that an empty TEST_CMD still turns tests off. Keep that fact and the decision reference, and drop the rest.
ADR 0132's *Tests* paragraph walks through each test case of src/core/pre-commit.test.ts and will drift as the tests change. It could keep only the setup fact: a temp repo with a logging `pnpm` stub.
